comment: dungeon.c restore_dungeon(): the restored game keeps the saved svd.dungeon_topology and relinks the saved branch list, without rerunning fixup_level_locations(). A debug Priest saves at once; the second segment restores, declines to keep the save file, opens the wizard level-teleport menu (whose Fort Ludios and Elemental Planes rows read the branch chain and the dummy-level depth_start), and picks Pri-loca from its second page. do.c goto_level() -> quest.c onquest() -> on_locate() then shows the locate-level quest text through questpgr.c com_pager_core(), whose nhl_init() draws the nhlib.lua shuffle. Seeds, datetimes and role were chosen independently of every recorded session.
